headline: [Financial Stocks] Fubon Financial Remains Profit Leader; H1 Adjusted EPS at NT$13.17 - Finance
summary: Fubon Financial Holding held its first-half investor conference, reporting after-tax net profit of NT$97.39 billion and EPS of NT$6.67. Gains from disposal of FVOCI equity instruments made up NT$91.07 billion of that profit.
why: Fubon Financial is one of Taiwan's largest financial holding companies, with banking, insurance and securities units. Its earnings are a benchmark for the health of Taiwan's financial sector.

impacts.name: Fubon Financial Holding
impacts.why: First-half results and a large one-off gain on equity disposals are reported for the company itself.
